title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: marine pollutant surcharge rate
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product the marine pollutant surcharge is the category's marine pollutant rate per container multiplied by the acceptance's container count, with no class, packing-group or lane uplift, no contract discount and no weight exemption applied to it, and it is stated to two decimal places.

## Rate by category
| Category | Marine pollutant rate (USD per container) |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 40.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 50.00 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 75.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 75.00 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 75.00 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 100.00 |

## What is not applied to this charge
| Adjustment | Applied to the marine pollutant surcharge |
|---|---|
| class uplift | no |
| packing-group uplift | no |
| trade-lane uplift | no |
| contract discount | no |
| weight exemption | no |

## Worked cases (hypothetical acceptances)
- AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives, 3 containers, packing group I, on Transpacific Eastbound: 75.00 multiplied by 3 is 225.00 — no uplift is added.
- AHL DG Limited Quantity, 2 containers, gross weight 3000 kg: 40.00 multiplied by 2 is 80.00 — the light weight does not exempt this charge.
- AHL DG Class 9 Standard, 4 containers, customer with an AHL Global Account Contract active: 50.00 multiplied by 4 is 200.00 — no contract discount.
